_about: How the game should feel, as numbers the tests measure (tests/test_feel.gd and the tests named in each 'measured_by'). A number outside its range fails CI. A range moves only with Sean's OK: change min/max, and add a line to 'history' with the date and his words. 'last' is what the tests measured when the range was agreed. A range marked 'proposed' was set from the game as it measured, not yet agreed: it still fails CI when the game drifts out of it.

body_hits_to_stop.unit: ball hits to the chest or belly before a man is out of the fight (average of 24)
history: 2026-09-28 Sean: 'he can take too many gunshots' (was 2.12, tuned to 1.46)
